run_discovery_k_shot_generation: run the Discovery class to generate 16-shot k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_discovery_classification_dataset: create a Discovery classification dataset instance with 180 discourse connector labels
load_discovery_hf_dataset: load the HuggingFace discovery dataset using datasets.load_dataset with the discovery config
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of sentence pairs with connector labels
get_train_test_lines: get shuffled train and test line lists from the discovery dataset with 10 percent test sampling
